bifrost: springboard/src/shell/atspi/ (AT-SPI2 bridge), springboard/ui/src/ax.rs, springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (controls_tree, ax_set), springboard/proto/src/lib.rs (Configure, reduce_motion, text_scale), springboard/src/shell/accessibility/mod.rs, springboard/src/shell/magnifier.rs, springboard/src/shell/assistive_touch.rs
summary: BifrOSt covers a Linux AT-SPI2 screen-reader bridge (roles, states, text attributes, text events, announcements, secure fields) and system display settings (zoom, reduce motion, increase contrast, reduce transparency, larger and bold text) that apps can read. The hierarchy API exists in the SDK but no app uses it yet, and there is no Accessibility Inspector, Switch Control, Voice Control, Braille, or audio-graph support.

features.apple: Accessibility API, VoiceOver, NSAccessibility element hierarchy
features.note: AT-SPI2 bus export of Accessible, Component, Action, Value, Text and EditableText; roles and states mapped in model.rs; unit tests only, untested on a live Orca. Feature-gated behind the atspi cargo feature.
Button, TextField, List, Row, Toggle, Checkbox, Slider, SegmentedControl, StaticText, MenuItem, Window are mapped; no table, selection, or rotor roles.
The SDK exposes controls_tree and View::controls_tree, but no app in springboard/apps overrides it yet, so every app reads as a flat list under its window.
Name falls back from label to title, Description from help to role name; SDK hooks App::ax_meta and View::ax_meta exist.

features.apple: AXSelectedText, AXSelectedTextRange, AXVisibleCharacterRange, text change notifications
features.note: Caret, selection and visible range are exported as char offsets; TextChanged, TextCaretMoved and TextSelectionChanged are diffed on publish. Implemented for the shell TextField only, plus the sign-in sheet's fields.
Value is masked and selected text is always empty; only the length crosses the wire.

features.apple: AccessibilityNotification, announcement requested (low, medium, high priority)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/ax.rs:52 (announce priority), Ctx::announce in the SDK
features.note: Maps to AT-SPI Object:Announcement with politeness; at most 8 pending per app. Live on a screen reader not verified.
Default ax_set maps Press to a tap and ignores SetValue and Focus; only apps that override ax_set accept them. Shared kit sliders and text fields do not yet.

features.feature: System accessibility settings readable by apps
features.apple: AccessibilitySettings (reduce motion, increase contrast, reduce transparency, larger text)
features.bifrost: springboard/proto/src/lib.rs:44 (Configure: reduce_motion, text_scale), springboard/render/src/appearance.rs (reduce_motion, increase_contrast, reduce_transparency), springboard/src/shell/accessibility/mod.rs
features.note: Apps receive reduce_motion and text_scale through Configure; contrast and transparency reach apps through the renderer (calendar-desktop follows them, see springboard/apps/calendar-desktop/CHANGELOG.md). No single SDK AccessibilitySettings struct.
Display Zoom is a 1.0 or 1.15 geometry factor, not a system-wide zoom. Magnifier is a camera loupe with digital zoom and filters, not a screen magnifier. No screen-wide zoom.
A floating Home button with six system shortcuts, plus hold-duration settings from 0.5 s to 2 s. No pointer-based keys or dwell control.
No switch scanning code found in springboard/ (search for switch control and dwell returned nothing).
No voice command code found in springboard/.

The element map in ui/src/ax.rs serves agents, not developers. No app-facing inspector shows an app's accessibility tree. The Web Inspector in springboard/apps/browser/src/inspector.rs covers web content only.
No Braille source code found; the only hits are generated build output under springboard/target.

features.feature: Audio graphs and hearing device support
features.note: No audio graph or hearing aid API found in this pass.

gaps: No app emits controls_tree, so the parent and hierarchy API is unused and every app is a flat list to screen readers.
The AT-SPI bridge is untested on a live Orca; unit tests cover only wire round trips and mapping.
Shell chrome (menu bar, dock, Spotlight, Settings pages) is missing from the AT-SPI tree.
ax_set ignores SetValue and Focus unless an app overrides it; the shared kit's sliders and text fields do not.
No Accessibility Inspector for developers to see an app's accessibility tree.
No Switch Control, Voice Control, Braille, or audio graph support.
Display Zoom is a 1.15 geometry factor, not a system-wide zoom, and the Magnifier is a camera loupe, not a screen magnifier.

Doc drift: docs/bifrost-ui.md lines 211-223 still list announcements, caret and secure fields as missing in the parity gaps, while the Closed-in-the-text-round section and ax.rs describe them as implemented. Reconcile the doc.
